verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ abhāvitaṁ abahulīkataṁ mahato anatthāya saṁvattati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, cittaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that, when it’s not developed and cultivated, is so very harmful as the mind.

verses.pali: Cittaṁ, bhikkhave, abhāvitaṁ abahulīkataṁ mahato anatthāya saṁvattatī”ti.
verses.english: An undeveloped and uncultivated mind is very harmful.”
